title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
婚礼仪式结束，全场灯光亮起，周舟和程澈作为双方家属，起身跟着新郎新娘一起去敬酒问好。自打靳吾栖进宴厅，尽管灯光暗，却还是有不少人注意到了他，所以这会儿已经有西装革履的alpha过来打招呼了。其中一个alpha余炀认识，某大集团的继承人，青年才俊，众星捧月。余炀喝完饮料，起身拿过椅背上的外套，去墙边的长桌上端了一盘小点心，然后推开阳台的门，站了出去。他随手把外套挂在阳台围栏上，将领带又松了松，从高楼俯视下去，繁华的街道被路灯染得金黄，车流缓缓游弋，渺小，遥远。看久了眼晕，余炀有些疲惫地往后退了一步靠在墙边，低头吃着小点心，他在餐桌上没有吃东西，现在空腹，再高级的奶油都难免显腻，余炀没吃几口就皱起眉，只觉得烦而躁。耳边传来开门声，余炀侧了侧头，应该是隔壁阳台有人出来，两个小阳台之间只隔着一点距离，因为间隔处架着一排绿草围绕的花卉装饰，夏末了还开得茂茂盛盛的，所以看不清隔壁阳台的人，尤其是余炀还靠在内侧的墙壁上，整个人就被挡了个严实。听脚步声应该不止一个人，余炀下意识地不愿意做个听者无心的人，他于是直起身子想要拿了外套走人。“靳先生，早就听说了你的公司，没想到背后的老板是你啊。”alpha带笑的声音被风携着灌进余炀的耳朵里。余炀静在原地，想确认他口中的“靳先生”是不是自己想到的那个omega。其实并不用听到回答，若有似无地开始飘过来的玫瑰香就可以佐证一切。“这有什么好奇怪的。”靳吾栖柔甜的声音像极了花架上盛开的花瓣，带着鲜嫩的颜色，在高处的晚风里轻轻摇曳，“再说了，难道知道老板是我了，你就要毁约了吗？”“要是知道是你……”alpha刻意放轻的尾音里带着显而易见的诱惑和挑逗，“当初签约的时候，我当然要当面跟你细谈了啊……”余炀垂眼看着自己手里那盘吃了几口的甜品，突然觉得，太过柔软甜美的东西，真的容易让人上瘾着迷，也真的会让人迸发出狠狠戒除的欲望。可惜戒断比上瘾难出百倍，沉迷只需一秒，脱身却要好多年。后来他们说了什么，余炀没听清，他只是闭上眼虚脱地站在原地，整个人像是被抽空了力气，连动动手指都不愿，任凭晚风呜咽般地吹过耳畔，他是真的觉得累。无论是四年来情绪上的隐忍压抑，还是繁忙工作下的身心俱疲，又或是心里那根始终拔不出来的刺。一切都，太折磨人了。又是一声开门声响起，余炀听到隔壁阳台传来程澈的声音：“哥。”“什么事？”靳吾栖问。程澈没说话，靳吾栖身旁的alpha也是个有眼色的，笑着说了一句“那就下次聊”，便道了别离场了。“余炀呢？”程澈问。“我不知道。”靳吾栖的声音轻飘飘的，“你来我这里找余炀，显然不会有结果。”汜减zcw*汜程澈顿了一下，说：“你明知道余炀没放下。”这头的余炀哑然失笑，刘海被风吹散在有些苍白的额头上，高楼的灯火倒映不进他的眼底。

“这你要问他了。”靳吾栖的声音里带着散漫的笑意。&#29306&#22914&#32&#57&#98&#122&#119&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914程澈问：“那你呢。”“我啊……”靳吾栖的语气飘飘渺渺的，余炀不确定他有没有喝酒，刚刚在桌上他并没有关注靳吾栖，又或是夜风会将声音吹散，所以听起来总是有些不真切。可是余炀还是听清楚了，他听见靳吾栖说：“我跟余炀吗？最多最多……当炮友吧。”轻描淡写的一句话，将余炀心头那根悬着千钧的发丝毫不留情地割断，一瞬间把他从眩晕的危楼抛到不见底的深渊，末了还在他的胸口砸上巨石，要他不能翻身。余炀抬起头，对着迢迢远处冰凉的月，微微张了张嘴。“何必呢。”他无声地自语。然后他转身推开门，回到了宴会厅，被搁在栏杆上的外套衣摆在风里萋萋摇曳。程澈盯着靳吾栖的眼睛，冷冷地开口：“如果你这样想，那最好别再去打扰余炀了。”靳吾栖是他的表哥，余炀是他的朋友，是周舟十几年的发小，程澈不想看他们再将关系弄到难堪的境地里去，何况余炀这几年是怎么过来的，程澈一清二楚。靳吾栖笑起来，他转头望着远处的灯火，侧脸快要融进夜色，他明明就站在视线里，却好像没办法让人捕捉到什么。情绪，笑意，念头，都抓不住，程澈也无法堪透。“我被标记过了，程澈。”靳吾栖戚叹般地开口，“永久标记。”他偏过头来，嘴边噙着笑，眼睛里却是平静又淡漠的：“凭我这样，难道还有资格要余炀跟我谈恋爱？”靳吾栖和程澈回到大厅的时候，新郎新娘的亲友们正站在一起准备拍合照，余炀一个一米九多的alpha低着头站在周桥面前挨骂。“余总真忙啊，忙着工作还是约会呢？”周桥仰着下巴瞥向余炀，握着捧花一下一下地将它往另一只手的手心上拍，仿佛那不是一支捧花，而是一根准备用来打人的鞭子。“工作呢。”余炀说，他笑了笑，“姐姐，别生气了，多好的日子，笑一笑呗。”周桥本来就是装着样子逗余炀玩的，她绷不住地笑出声来，将捧花往余炀怀里一塞：“我倒希望你约会去了，有喜欢的人了吗？有的话记得抓紧了啊。”余光里是靳吾栖往这边走来的身影，灯光明亮到晃眼，余炀看着手里的花束，睫毛微微阖动了一下，然后他抬起头，笑着说：“没有喜欢的人了。”大合照上，余炀与靳吾栖分别站在新郎新娘的两侧，脸上定格着清淡的笑意。芈何芈我心有锐刺，不堪触碰，不如筑起高墙，在鲜血里泅住残余的自尊。※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※在微博请过假啦，这几天调整休息一下。喜欢长夏醒迟abo请大家收藏：长夏醒迟abo更新速度最快。

After the wedding ceremony ended, the lights in the entire venue came on. Zhou Zhou and Cheng Che, as family members of both parties, stood up and followed the bride and groom to toast and say hello.Since Jin Wuqi entered the banquet hall, even though the lights were dim, many people still noticed him, so at this moment, there were already alphas in suits and ties coming over to say hello.One of the alphas, Yu Yang, knew him. He was the heir to a large group, a young talent who was admired by all the stars.After Yu Yang finished his drink, he stood up and took his coat from the back of the chair, went to the long table by the wall to get a plate of snacks, then opened the balcony door and stood out.He casually hung his coat on the balcony railing and loosened his tie. Looking down from the tall building, the bustling streets were dyed golden by the street lights, and the traffic flowed slowly, small and distant.Feeling dizzy after looking at it for a long time, Yu Yang took a step back tiredly and leaned against the wall, lowering his head to eat some snacks. He didn't eat at the table, and now that he was on an empty stomach, no matter how high-grade the cream was, he would inevitably feel greasy. Yu Yang frowned after taking only a few bites, feeling irritated and restless.Hearing the sound of opening the door, Yu Yang turned his head. Someone must have come out from the balcony next door. There was only a little distance between the two small balconies because there was a row of flower decorations surrounded by green grass. They were still in full bloom at the end of summer, so he couldn't see the people on the balcony next door. Especially since Yu Yang was still leaning against the inner wall, his whole body was blocked.Hearing the footsteps, there must be more than one person. Yu Yang subconsciously didn't want to be a careless listener, so he straightened up and wanted to take his coat and leave."Mr. Jin, I've heard about your company a long time ago. I didn't expect that the boss behind it was you." The alpha's laughing voice was carried by the wind into Yu Yang's ears.Yu Yang stood still, trying to confirm whether the "Mr. Jin" he mentioned was the omega he thought of.In fact, there is no need to hear an answer. The scent of roses that seems to be floating from nowhere can prove everything."What's so strange about this?" Jin Wuqi's soft and sweet voice was like the petals blooming on the flower stand, with fresh colors, gently swaying in the evening breeze at a high place, "Besides, do you know that the boss is me, will you break the contract?" "If I knew it was you..." Alpha's tail tone was deliberately soft.With obvious temptation and teasing, "When I signed the contract, of course I had to discuss it with you in person..." Yu Yang looked down at the plate of desserts in his hand that he had taken a few bites of, and suddenly felt that something that was too soft and sweet could really make people addicted, and it would really make people want to quit.Unfortunately, withdrawal is a hundred times harder than addiction. It only takes a second to become addicted, but it takes years to escape.What they said later, Yu Yang didn't hear clearly. He just closed his eyes and stood there in exhaustion. His whole body seemed to have been drained of energy, and he didn't even want to move his fingers. He let the night wind blow past his ears like a whine. He really felt tired.Whether it’s the emotional suppression of the past four years, the physical and mental exhaustion from busy work, or the thorn in my heart that I can’t pull out.Everything is so excruciating.Another sound of the door opening sounded, and Yu Yang heard Cheng Che's voice coming from the balcony next door: "Brother." "What's the matter?" Jin Wuqi asked.Cheng Che didn't say anything, and the alpha next to Jin Wuqi also had a winking look. He smiled and said, "Let's talk next time," and then said goodbye and left."Where's Yu Yang?" Cheng Che asked."I don't know." Jin Wuqi's voice was light and airy, "You come to me to look for Yu Yang, obviously there will be no results." 朜 reduce zcw * 汜 Cheng Che paused and said, "You know that Yu Yang has not let go." Yu Yang on the other side laughed dumbly, his bangs were blown by the wind on his somewhat pale forehead, and the lights of the tall buildings were not reflected in his eyes.

"You have to ask him about this." Jin Wuqi's voice contained a casual smile.&#29306&#22914&#32&#57&#98&#122&#119&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914 Cheng Che asked: "What about you." "I..." Jin Wuqi's tone was vague. Yu Yang was not sure if he had drank. He had not paid attention to Jin Wuqi at the table just now, or the night wind would have blown the sound away, so it always sounded a bit unreal.But Yu Yang still heard it clearly. He heard Jin Wuqi say: "Me and Yu Yang? At most... let's be gun buddies." With such an understatement, Yu Yang's heart was cut off without mercy, and in an instant he was thrown from the dizzy dangerous building to the bottomless abyss. In the end, a huge boulder was thrown on his chest to prevent him from turning over.Yu Yang raised his head, faced the cold moon in the distance, and opened his mouth slightly."Why bother." He said silently to himself.Then he turned around and pushed open the door, returning to the banquet hall. The coat he placed on the railing was swaying in the wind.Cheng Che stared into Jin Wuqi's eyes and said coldly: "If you think so, it's best not to bother Yu Yang anymore." Jin Wuqi is his cousin, Yu Yang is his friend, and Zhou Zhou's childhood friend for more than ten years. Cheng Che doesn't want to see their relationship get into an embarrassing situation again, not to mention how Yu Yang got here in the past few years, Cheng Che knows everything.Jin Wuqi laughed. He turned his head and looked at the lights in the distance, his side face almost melting into the night. He was clearly standing in sight, but it seemed that no one could catch anything.Emotions, smiles, and thoughts couldn't be grasped, and Cheng Che couldn't stand it either."I have been marked, Cheng Che." Jin Wuqi sighed and said, "Permanently marked." He turned his head with a smile on his lips, but his eyes were calm and indifferent: "Am I qualified to ask Yu Yang to fall in love with me?" When Jin Wuqi and Cheng Che returned to the hall, the relatives and friends of the bride and groom were standing together to take a group photo, and Yu Yang, an alpha who was over 1.9 meters tall, stood in front of Zhou Qiao with his head lowered and being scolded."Mr. Yu is really busy, are you busy with work or on a date?" Zhou Qiao raised his chin and glanced at Yu Yang, holding the bouquet and slapping it on the palm of his other hand, as if it was not a bouquet, but a whip ready to hit someone."It's work." Yu Yang said, and he smiled, "Sister, don't be angry, it's such a wonderful day, just smile." Zhou Qiao was just pretending to tease Yu Yang, she couldn't help laughing out loud, and stuffed the bouquet into Yu Yang's arms: "I hope you are going on a date, do you have someone you like? If you do, remember to hold on tight.." In the corner of his eye was Jin Wuqi walking towards him. The light was so bright that it was dazzling. Yu Yang looked at the bouquet in his hand, his eyelashes fluttered slightly, then he raised his head and said with a smile, "There is no one I like anymore." In the group photo, Yu Yang and Jin Wuqi were standing on both sides of the bride and groom, with light smiles on their faces.Mihe Miwo has a sharp thorn in my heart that cannot be touched. It is better to build a high wall and swim in the blood to keep the remaining self-esteem.※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※I have asked for leave on Weibo, and I am taking a rest these days.If you like Changxia Xingchi abo, please collect it: Changxia Xingchi abo is updated the fastest.

“这你要问他了。”靳吾栖的声音里带着散漫的笑意。&#29306&#22914&#32&#57&#98&#122&#119&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914程澈问：“那你呢。”“我啊……”靳吾栖的语气飘飘渺渺的，余炀不确定他有没有喝酒，刚刚在桌上他并没有关注靳吾栖，又或是夜风会将声音吹散，所以听起来总是有些不真切。可是余炀还是听清楚了，他听见靳吾栖说：“我跟余炀吗？最多最多……当炮友吧。”轻描淡写的一句话，将余炀心头那根悬着千钧的发丝毫不留情地割断，一瞬间把他从眩晕的危楼抛到不见底的深渊，末了还在他的胸口砸上巨石，要他不能翻身。余炀抬起头，对着迢迢远处冰凉的月，微微张了张嘴。“何必呢。”他无声地自语。然后他转身推开门，回到了宴会厅，被搁在栏杆上的外套衣摆在风里萋萋摇曳。程澈盯着靳吾栖的眼睛，冷冷地开口：“如果你这样想，那最好别再去打扰余炀了。”靳吾栖是他的表哥，余炀是他的朋友，是周舟十几年的发小，程澈不想看他们再将关系弄到难堪的境地里去，何况余炀这几年是怎么过来的，程澈一清二楚。靳吾栖笑起来，他转头望着远处的灯火，侧脸快要融进夜色，他明明就站在视线里，却好像没办法让人捕捉到什么。情绪，笑意，念头，都抓不住，程澈也无法堪透。“我被标记过了，程澈。”靳吾栖戚叹般地开口，“永久标记。”他偏过头来，嘴边噙着笑，眼睛里却是平静又淡漠的：“凭我这样，难道还有资格要余炀跟我谈恋爱？”靳吾栖和程澈回到大厅的时候，新郎新娘的亲友们正站在一起准备拍合照，余炀一个一米九多的alpha低着头站在周桥面前挨骂。“余总真忙啊，忙着工作还是约会呢？”周桥仰着下巴瞥向余炀，握着捧花一下一下地将它往另一只手的手心上拍，仿佛那不是一支捧花，而是一根准备用来打人的鞭子。“工作呢。”余炀说，他笑了笑，“姐姐，别生气了，多好的日子，笑一笑呗。”周桥本来就是装着样子逗余炀玩的，她绷不住地笑出声来，将捧花往余炀怀里一塞：“我倒希望你约会去了，有喜欢的人了吗？有的话记得抓紧了啊。”余光里是靳吾栖往这边走来的身影，灯光明亮到晃眼，余炀看着手里的花束，睫毛微微阖动了一下，然后他抬起头，笑着说：“没有喜欢的人了。”大合照上，余炀与靳吾栖分别站在新郎新娘的两侧，脸上定格着清淡的笑意。芈何芈我心有锐刺，不堪触碰，不如筑起高墙，在鲜血里泅住残余的自尊。※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※在微博请过假啦，这几天调整休息一下。喜欢长夏醒迟abo请大家收藏：长夏醒迟abo更新速度最快。
